status: Restricted candidates; data diagnostics, analytical tests and synthetic checks distinguished

candidate1.model: Stationary fixed-speed path memory: dlnnu/dell=-kappa; arrival map t_o=t_e+R/c
candidate1.prediction: Frequency redshift but no envelope dilation
candidate1.verdict: Fails the width diagnostic under its published source/reference assumptions; richer time-dependent memory remains open

candidate2.prediction: Spectral and envelope factors both exp(kappa R)
candidate2.other_checks: Prior fixed-atom electromagnetic completion fails leading hyperfine invariance; exact shared tensor action absent
candidate2.alternative: A kinetic normalization alone changes leading amplitude, not the null cone or leading geometric-optics frequency on a static metric

candidate3.model: Band-dependent envelope law width=(1+z)^b_band; a proxy for chromatic temporal transport, not a spectral-redshift model
candidate3.limits: No interband/reference covariance provided; bootstrap addresses event sampling only. No inference across atomic, radio or gravitational-wave frequencies.

candidate4.conformal_subfamily: Prior derivation: stable local matter ratios and shared characteristics, but fixed material scale implies zero homogeneous redshift
candidate4.genuinely_nonconformal: No full action satisfying matter, tensor and stable background requirements; no new fit score is assignable
candidate4.interpretation: The earlier geometry fit is kinematic and does not validate this unspecified action

candidate5.model: Thermal reservoir with detailed balance; compare blackbody and equal-weight mixtures of redshifted thermal components
candidate5.threshold_convention: Delta chi2=3.841 relative to delta=0; approximate diagnostic, not exact boundary-calibrated confidence limit
candidate5.identifiability: Equilibrium fit does not identify reservoir origin, rate, temperature derivation, kappa or energy budget
candidate5.caveat: FIRAS released residuals and diagonal errors only. No full covariance, absolute temperature recalibration or angular CMB test.

common_caveats: DES derived widths inherit reference-curve dilation assumptions; no raw-light-curve fit or independent confirmation.
All data reused; no newly blinded observations.
No candidate has a completed stable nonexpanding matter-light-gravity action.
Stationary transfer with fixed path maps delayed copies, not a stretch of the entire time axis; arbitrary broadening is not the same observable.
